why: Spec says 'blocked = no public API', but Sherlock and Mermaid CLI are open-source CLIs that a sandboxed toolkit can run directly. They need a wrapper, not permission, so friction rather than blocked. Applied the same ruling to Mermaid CLI for consistency.
Free Sandbox plus an auto-approved free Trial with live data means a developer can build and test today. Production approval is a launch concern, not a build blocker.
